messages: marie (Design): quick sync — want to finalize the Settings form signals + validation UX + delete-team confirmation copy. trying to avoid pattern sprawl. dan (PM): please list the options and the recommended tradeoffs. kai (DevEx): accessibility flag: SRs must be told which fields are required and when validation appears. avoid color-only cues. faye (Eng): low-variance preferred. focus management on multi-step flows is the trickiest bit. marie (Design): naming the pattern 'safety affirmations': three parts — required marker, validation feedback, and destructive confirmation. marie (Design): Required marker options: (1) micro-asterisk + top legend, (2) muted "Required" pill, (3) inline helper text. My lean: asterisk for compact lists, pill for mobile-dense pages. dan (PM): rationale? marie (Design): asterisk is minimal visually; pill reads better on narrow widths and for low-contrast themes. both must include sr-only text and aria-required. kai (DevEx): confirm: add required + input[@aria-required=\"true\"]. also test with NVDA/VoiceOver. faye (Eng): sounds fine. add a layout-level toggle (legend vs pill) not per-field flags to avoid complexity. marie (Design): Validation feedback: single-step -> inline error under field (short). multi-step/wizard -> condensed 'step summary' banner that lists issues and anchors to fields. banner shows count and first-line preview. dan (PM): users often miss inline errors in long steps, so the banner is important. kai (DevEx): banner must be an aria-live polite region when it first appears and links should move focus to the associated field and announce label+error. link activation should set focus to the field, not just scroll. faye (Eng): implementation note: add data-error-id attributes, single JS handler does focus jump + prevents full-form rehydrate. debounce validation updates to 300ms to avoid noisy reflows. marie (Design): error text style: short imperative copy ("Enter a valid email") and avoid internal jargon. include a tiny hint for recovery actions where appropriate. dan (PM): delete-team workflow — options: (A) simple confirm modal + undo toast, (B) typed-confirm for all deletes, (C) conditional typed-confirm for org-level or >X members. which do we pick? marie (Design): prefer C: lightweight deletes use modal+undo; org-level/team-size threshold triggers typed-confirm. call it an "affirmation step" and surface why it's required. kai (DevEx): typed-confirm a11y: visible label, aria-describedby instructions, primary disabled until exact match, mismatch announced via role=alert. ensure focus trap and keyboard-only flow. faye (Eng): backend supports 14-day soft-delete; we should mention restore window in the modal only if product confirms. client-side match checks, server-side delete call only when confirmed. avoid server calls on every keypress. dan (PM): legal will want clarity. we'll only mention restore window after sign-off. marie (Design): suggested modal copy (draft): - Title: "Permanently delete team" - Body: "This will permanently delete the team and its data. This action cannot be undone. To confirm, type the full team name:" - Input label: "Type team name to confirm" - Primary: "Delete team" (disabled until exact match). Secondary: "Cancel" - Small note (conditional): "Items may be recoverable for 14 days." if soft-delete enabled. kai (DevEx): acceptance criteria I'll add to the ticket: focus trap, aria-describedby, role=alert on mismatch, primary button uses aria-disabled, keyboard walkthrough steps, SR regression tests. faye (Eng): engineering acceptance: layout-level switch for marker, data-error-id anchors, single focus handler, debounce 300ms, avoid whole-form rerender on validation ticks. also throttle banner updates to avoid jitter. marie (Design): one more UX nit — when a user corrects an error in a field, remove the field-level error immediately but only update the banner after debounce so count doesn't flicker. keep error removal visually immediate. dan (PM): good. who will update Figma/spec? marie (Design): I'll update Figma and the spec doc tonight and link in the ticket. deploy-bot: branch feature/safety-affirmations pushed for review — PR #612 marie (Design): thanks all — final decision: asterisk for compact, pill for dense/mobile, inline errors for single-step, condensed step-summary banner with anchors for multi-step, conditional typed-confirm for org-level deletes + undo/soft-delete messaging after legal sign-off. I'll post the spec and acceptance criteria.
